name: Imgur

sources.title: Imgur registration page — sign-up only via Continue with Google / Continue with Apple

conditions: Posting is free, but account creation now routes exclusively through Google or Apple OAuth — no standalone email signup shown on the register page
requirements: Imgur is an image-hosting/community site, not a product directory — the only 'listing' is a public image post or a profile
Public posts are subject to community rules and voting; overt self-promotion is commonly downvoted/removed
preparation: A Google or Apple account to register with (no email/password option visible)
Image/GIF assets of the product worth posting
A post title and description; optional tags
workflow: Register at imgur.com/register via Google or Apple
Upload images via 'New post' and set the post to public
Add title, description (can include the product URL), and tags
Optionally complete the account profile with a bio and website link
watchFor: Imgur actively deprioritizes/removes spammy promotional posts — treat it as a community, not a directory
Hidden (unlisted) images don't appear publicly; only public posts and profile links are indexable
Registration is OAuth-only (Google/Apple) — credential-based signup was not offered on the fetched page
countsAsLive: A public Imgur post URL resolves and is visible without login, or the profile page shows the website link
unknowns: Whether profile/post outbound links are followed or nofollow (not verifiable from the register page)
Current moderation stance on brand accounts
